mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_record (user_id, question_id, book_id, question_seq, answer, answer_attachment, answer_attachment_name, is_correct, is_answered) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{bookId}, #{questionSeq}, #{answer}, #{answerAttachment}, #{answerAttachmentName}, #{isCorrect}, #{isAnswered})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) FROM question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND is_correct = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM question_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY do_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT qr.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q2 WHERE q2.book_id = #{bookId} AND q2.id <= qr.question_id) as question_seq FROM question_record qr WHERE qr.user_id = #{userId} AND qr.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY qr.question_id ASC

SELECT qr.id, qr.user_id, qr.question_id, qr.book_id, qr.question_seq, qr.answer, qr.answer_attachment, qr.answer_attachment_name, qr.is_correct, qr.is_answered, qr.do_time, q.id as q_id, q.book_id as q_book_id, q.type_id as q_type_id, q.content as q_content, q.options as q_options, q.answer as q_answer, q.analysis as q_analysis, q.difficulty as q_difficulty, q.attachment as q_attachment, q.attachment_name as q_attachment_name, qt.type_name as q_type_name, eb.book_name as q_book_name, COUNT(qr.id) as error_count FROM question_record qr LEFT JOIN question q ON qr.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN question_type qt ON q.type_id = qt.id LEFT JOIN exercise_book eb ON q.book_id = eb.id WHERE qr.user_id = #{userId} AND qr.is_correct = 0 GROUP BY qr.question_id, q.id, q.book_id, q.type_id, q.content, q.options, q.answer, q.analysis, q.difficulty, q.attachment, q.attachment_name, qt.type_name, eb.book_name, qr.id, qr.user_id, qr.book_id, qr.question_seq, qr.answer, qr.answer_attachment, qr.answer_attachment_name, qr.is_correct, qr.is_answered, qr.do_time ORDER BY error_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT qr.*, q.id as q_id, q.book_id as q_book_id, q.type_id as q_type_id, q.content as q_content, q.options as q_options, q.answer as q_answer, q.analysis as q_analysis, q.difficulty as q_difficulty, q.attachment as q_attachment, q.attachment_name as q_attachment_name, qt.type_name as q_type_name FROM question_record qr LEFT JOIN question q ON qr.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN question_type qt ON q.type_id = qt.id WHERE qr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY qr.do_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
